text:
suresh: Heads up — noticed a reproducible instability + quality regression on AWQ when group_size=32 + act-quant enabled under sustained high QPS. Canaries hit ~400 QPS and we see intermittent hallucination-like outputs and eval deltas.

maya: saw the spike on the latency/cost dashboard, filing here. dashboard: https://internal.redwood/d/dash-xyz/awq-canary?orgId=1 :eyes:

tom: what metric shows regression? raw logs?

eval-bot: nightly-eval summary for model-x awq-g32-actq @2026-03-18: MMLU acc -2.3% vs fp16 baseline, Winograd-coded BLEU/chrF for summarization -1.7 pts, avg token-likelihood variance increased ~1.8x.

lina: interesting — act quant + group packing changes prefix smoothing. Could be batcher-level KV misalignment or stale KV cache after continuous batching.

suresh: repro steps I used: run local runner with: `python tools/run_serving.py --model model-x --profile awq-g32-actq --qps 400 --seq-len 512 --continuous-batching` . After ~20 minutes, errors start showing in samples (weird token repeats and off-topic completions).

maya: pasted a short log snippet: ```
[2026-03-18T15:12:05Z] WARN kv_cache: mismatch at shard-7 seq-128 expected-offset=1024 actual=1008
[2026-03-18T15:12:06Z] ERROR decode: out-of-bound KV read, fallback to fp16 decoder
[2026-03-18T15:12:07Z] INFO model-serve: returned 200 but qualitative-eval failed
```

tom: kv mismatch smells like batching window boundary issue. If group-size packs tokens into groups then act-quant layout changes could shift offsets. Did you run with `kv_prealloc=true`?

suresh: yes, kv_prealloc=true. I also tried kv_prealloc=false and saw less frequent but still present. Tested group_size=16 -> regression disappears. group_size=64 -> worse. Looks like non-linear sensitivity.

lina: that pattern suggests per-group padding/alignment effects interacting with act-quant packing. Could be pointer arithmetic in our AWQ fused kernel when group_size % warp != 0.

maya: quick config we used: ```json
{
  "profile": "awq-g32-actq",
  "group_size": 32,
  "act_quant": true,
  "kv_prealloc": true,
  "continuous_batching": true,
  "seq_len": 512
}
```

tom: plan: 1) reproduce with sampler that dumps conditional offsets per group; 2) instrument fused kernel for boundary checks; 3) run eval harness at QPS=50/200/400 to map failure probability.

suresh: assigned tasks: maya run steady-state canary on dedicated pool w/ debug logs (retention 1h). tom add extra asserts in awq-kernel for group-indexing and ship a debug build. lina to look at quant layout code around activation packing. I'll run the eval harness and collect failing seeds.

infra-bot: note — increased log retention for canary pool redwood-dedicated-12 for 2 hours as requested by maya.

maya: quick results from small sweep: QPS 50: no regression; QPS 200: 0.7% MMLU drop intermittently (~2% runs); QPS 400: 2.3% drop stable. group_size=16 baseline no drop. group_size=48 & 56 divergent too.

lina: hypothesis v1 — padding -> misindexing in awq int8 packing path; hypothesis v2 — quantized act ordering + cached KV reuse sometimes picks wrong slice when batch boundaries overlap. Both produce off-by-N token alignment errors which then cascade.

tom: I added guards and a counter metric `awq.group_index_mismatch` (increment on detected boundary mismatch). On debug canary saw spikes matching the failing windows.

suresh: good. next prioritize fix: safer guard + fallback to fp16 decode for impacted requests + add rollout gating. We should also add an automated eval check: when canary shows MMLU drop >1% vs baseline, auto-rollback.

maya: can we mitigate quickly via runtime config? Maybe force group-batch flush at seq boundaries or disable continuous batching for awq-g32-actq on Dedicated for now. That should buy us time.

lina: agree. quick mitigation: set `continuous_batching=false` for profile awq-g32-actq in rollout policy and alert on `awq.group_index_mismatch` > 100/min.

eval-bot: suggested rollout gating rule: if eval delta MMLU >1% OR charF drop >1.5 pts within 30m for canary cohort -> rollback profile.

maya: I'll patch the rollout policy and schedule a canary tomorrow morning low-traffic window. tom — can you open a PR for the kernel guards and link here?

tom: opened PR #1428 — adds bound checks, metric increments, and a debug-only KV dump. Please review. https://phabricator.redwood/PR/1428 :shipit:

suresh: thanks. We'll aim to revert policy when PR lands and passes canary. Keep logs + failing seeds attached to the phab ticket.

lina: one more ask — add a small unit test that fuzzes group sizes from 8..64 with random seq lengths to catch alignment issues in CI.

suresh: agreed. I'll add seeds from failing runs to the regression suite.

maya: thanks team. keeping this thread as the coordination log. If anything new pops up paste samples here (inputs + outputs). :thumbsup:

infra-bot: deploy-bot: canary rollout scheduled 2026-03-19T08:00Z for profile awq-g32-actq with continuous_batching=false as temporary mitigation.

suresh: closing the loop after canary results.
